target_customer: Software and security teams at companies that run web applications, from startups to large firms
problem: Traditional web application firewalls sit at the network edge and miss or mis-handle application level attacks; developers wanted protection embedded in the app.

founders.name: Bjoern Zinssmeister
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no background. Search summaries of Fortune coverage say he and Matthias Kadenbach were former Synack engineers; I did not open that article, so employers and the co-founder are not recorded.

technical_complexity.rationale: Embedding detection and blocking agents into customer applications across stacks without breaking them is real engineering, but uses known techniques.

defensibility.rationale: WAF and runtime protection vendors were established and a new agent based product had no data or network moat in 2018.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Edge WAF features from large cloud vendors remained the default, and Templarbit was bought in 2022 by a cyber insurer, BOXX Insurance, for its threat intelligence platform.

market_need_then: Fortune's 2018 coverage framed WAFs as legacy and reported early customers including Mercedes-Benz and Match.com.

branding.domain_note: templarbit.com, an exact .com; no purchase story found. Site returned 503 on fetch.

brand_strength.rationale: A distinctive knight themed sounding name but no sourced brand coverage, merch or community; the knight reading is unsourced.

outcome_analysis: Templarbit raised a 3 million dollar seed led by 205 Capital in February 2018 with early enterprise customers, then moved toward cyber threat intelligence and was acquired by BOXX Insurance in November 2022 at an undisclosed price. No later funding was found and no stated reason for the sale, so the exit is best read as a modest strategic acquisition of unknown quality.
notes: Seed seen in Fortune (via search listing) and Seedtable; Crunchbase lists a later Series A that I could not verify, and some aggregators label the 2018 round Series A. Persana gives a 2023-10 acquisition date that conflicts with the 2022-11 news coverage. Two competitor searches found only undated directory pages (Signal Sciences, Cloudflare WAF, Sqreen), so the list is empty. Success and failure factors left empty because the sources do not support a clear story.
